phases.goal: Grip the microphone handle with one arm.
phases.name: secure_mic_handle
phases.verify: The handle moves with the gripper without slipping.

phases.goal: Transfer or stabilize the microphone for the final hold.
phases.name: transfer_mic
phases.verify: The microphone remains secured after the transfer.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Grip the handle rather than the microphone head.
Transfer only when the receiving hold or stable support is visible.

roles.protected: microphone head and handle orientation remain visible

task_language: Secure the smooth plastic microphone handle using one arm and transfer it.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid blocking the transfer path with the receiving hand; verify the microphone handle remains controlled until the receiving hold is secure.
